verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec with explicit versioning (figma-docs-46, figma-probe-rt-3: OpenAPI 3.1.0, version 0.42.0) and maintains a public REST API changelog documenting breaking-ish changes like renaming 'projects' to 'folders' and adding new endpoints (figma-docs-47, figma-docs-58, figma-docs-48). This shows API versioning and change tracking in practice, but no evidence cites an explicit, documented deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, backward-compatibility guarantees) that AI-native integrators could rely on. Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation-policy document/section, stated support windows for old API versions, and independent confirmation that deprecated endpoints are handled predictably.
